title: Drawer stays open across project switches until closed
notes:
Bug from using 2.41.0: open the drawer, switch to another project, come back, and the drawer is closed.

Fix: the drawer's open state is one app-wide value, not per page. Open it and it stays open on every tab, the manager's too, until the button or Ctrl+Shift+D closes it. Switching tabs shows that tab's docs and sessions in the open drawer, and keeps each project's open folders and selection as today. Focus after a switch goes where it goes today (the page), not into the drawer. Not persisted across an app restart.

comments.body: PR #164: open state is app-wide; a tab switch lists the page in front instead of closing the drawer. drawerFollows decides, tested. drawer-decision-4. 2.41.1. Not checked by hand in the app.
